literal_meaning: onomatopoeic reduplicated sound for quickly slurping or gulping liquid
figurative_meaning_bn: দ্রুত তরলদ্রব্য খাওয়ার ধ্বন্যাত্মক দ্বিত্বশব্দ; এক নিশ্বাসে ও সাগ্রহে
figurative_meaning_en: onomatopoeic reduplicated word for quickly drinking liquid; in one breath and eagerly
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাচ্চাটা চোঁচোঁ করে স্যুপ খেয়ে ফেলল।
example_sentences_in_english: Gulp down the milk quickly and eagerly.
The child slurped up the soup in one go.
note: This is a vivid onomatopoeic expression rooted in everyday Bengali speech, often used to describe enthusiastic consumption of liquids like milk or soup.
